title: How do I post a missed-payment recovery for a Corporate Wellness Partnership enrollment?
content:
A payment intended to bring the employer's master account current must be posted only once every currently due charge, including any outstanding late-payment fee, has been billed against the enrollment. Once that holds, posting the payment toward a Corporate Wellness Partnership enrollment decreases the net amount currently owed by the employer's master account and adds a payment entry to the enrollment's billing history.

This is done using an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call): post_corp_dues_payment_af691ae5.

Parameters:
- enrollment_id — the reference number of the enrollment the payment is being applied to, read from the enrollment record.
- amount_usd — the dollar amount actually applied against the balance, in USD, rounded to exactly 2 decimal places.

Return: a confirmation of the new payment-history entry's reference number, the amount applied, and the enrollment's resulting balance owed by the employer's master account. This action defines no error condition beyond the enrollment reference not being found.
